comment: Engine mutation-score floor (caught / viable %, no_tests excluded), enforced nightly by scripts/mutation_gate.py. Re-measured 50.99% on 2026-07-03 (1540 killed + 0 timeout / 3020 viable; 663 no_tests) after harness-enforce-and-deepen Steps 2-4 added the property + action suites to [tool.mutmut].tests_dir. Floor HELD at 45 (not ratcheted up): the ratio FELL from 52.5% because covering actions/ moved ~362 mutants out of no_tests into the viable pool and 804/1480 survivors now live in actions/ — the happy-path/rejection tests cover those files but kill few of their mutants. Absolute kills rose (1310->1540); the ratio is a coverage-conditioned denominator effect. (Local run showed timeout=0 vs CI's 85, so this local number understates the CI score.) Ratchet upward only after actions/ mutation tests are strengthened; lower only behind the harness-change label.
